job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly driven AI Engineer to build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered solutions across products and internal systems. The ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving abilities, hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks, and the ability to independently own projects end-to-end. This role requires someone who can work in a fast-paced startup environment, experiment rapidly, and translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and applications.
Build and optimize LLM-based workflows, chatbots, AI assistants, and automation
systems.
Work on prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and AI orchestration
frameworks.
Fine-tune and evaluate AI models for performance, accuracy, and scalability.
Integrate AI capabilities into web platforms, APIs, and enterprise applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business problems and deliver
AI-driven solutions.
Research emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative implementations.
Monitor model performance and continuously improve reliability and efficiency.
Maintain documentation, testing standards, and deployment processes.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.
Experience working with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models.
Understanding of Prompt Engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and AI
agents.
Experience with APIs, backend integration, and cloud platforms.
Knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to take ownership and work independently.



What Were Looking For

Strong ownership mindset and execution ability.
Curiosity to explore and implement new AI technologies.
Ability to work with minimal supervision.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Passion for building impactful AI products.



Why Join Us

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI products and real-world applications.
Fast-paced startup environment with high ownership and growth.
Exposure to advanced AI technologies and innovation-driven projects.
Collaborative and learning-focused culture.
